name: RIWF E4 Repeat Previous, lags unknown, confirmatory plan
spec: e4/plan.md (written 2026-09-28, status before pilot); this file freezes it with the pilot outcome
environment: POPGym RepeatPrevious(num_decks=1, k) from popgym==1.0.7. Correct action at step t under lag k is o_{t-k+1} for t >= k; reward +-1/(52-k) there, 0 before. 51 steps. Inputs: one-hot suit only.
port: e4/rprev.py. Checked in every world against RepeatPrevious(1,4) on 200 seeded episodes (observations, rewards under a fixed random action sequence) and against RepeatPrevious(1,k) for k = 1..16 (the port's label earns the official +1/(52-k) at every posed step). Training batches come from the port. Held-out source episodes and the panel are dealt by official-environment resets; fresh target episodes are dealt and stepped by the official environment, and the port only computes labels.
shift: training and the known question pose lag 4; deployment poses the new lags 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, with lag 4 reported beside them
pool: GRU and LSTM of width 8, 32, 128; gated transformer (32-dim, 2 heads) with 2 blocks and window 8 or 32; gated transformer with 1 block and window 4 (tagged win4). Two training seeds each (seed + 7919 i + 13), snapshots at updates 150 and 300: 36 candidates. Candidate index follows architecture and size in that order.
memory: the policy head's input at every step, computed by one causal pass over the fixed observations (identical to stepping; checked)
admission: native source return (expected return of the stochastic policy at lag 4 on 512 held-out source episodes) within 0.10 of the best candidate in the world. The window-4-excluded pool is the admitted pool minus its win4 candidates, admission unchanged.
deficits: d_k for k = 1..51: cross-fitted 0-1 error of a multinomial logistic readout from the memory at step t to o_{t-k+1} over steps t >= k on the 512-episode panel, unit weights, five folds grouped by episode (the same folds for every candidate and lag in a world), L2 1e-3 (mean cross-entropy + 1e-3/2 |W|^2, bias unpenalised) on memories standardised on the training folds, L-BFGS (gtol 1e-6, ftol 1e-10, at most 500 iterations). common/fsel.deficit_multi_cv.

selectors.f_ign: min sum_k (52-k) d_k / sum_k (52-k) over k = 1..51 (proposed)
selectors.k_deploy: min mean of d_k over the deployed new lags (reference, flagged; never used by another selector)
selectors.skd: min d_4 cross-fitted on the held-out source episodes
selectors.mp: max mean max action probability at panel steps t >= 4
selectors.atc: max share of panel steps t >= 4 whose confidence exceeds the ATC threshold fitted on source steps t >= 4 (correct = argmax equals the lag-4 answer)
selectors.dis: min share of panel steps t >= 4 where the argmax action differs from the majority action of all 36 candidates
selectors.dev: min deep embedded validation risk, source memories and 1 - p(correct) at steps t >= 4 against panel memories at steps t >= 4
selectors.params: max parameter count of the whole network

ties: a selector's candidates within 1e-9 of its best score deploy with equal probability; endpoints are the mean over the tied set (common/anal tol=1e-9)
near_tie: per world, whether the two best candidates under k_known lie within 0.005 (lock: all candidates; analysis: admitted)
refit: multinomial logistic readout for every lag 1..16 fitted on the full panel, stored in the lock as float32; deployment uses the stored weights
target: 1000 fresh official episodes per world. s_k = share of steps t >= k where the stored readout answers o_{t-k+1}. n_known = expected native return at lag 4.

endpoints.primary: l_new = mean s_k over the six new lags
endpoints.gap_closure: sum over worlds of (selector - admitted mean) / (oracle - admitted mean), 50,000 bootstrap resamples
endpoints.tail: share of worlds deploying a bottom-quartile l_new candidate

hypotheses.family: Holm over sixteen one-sided sign-flip tests (one million flips): H1 and H2 on the admitted pool and on the pool without win4
hypotheses.H1: f_ign beats k_known on l_new; beside it k_known minus f_ign on l_known and the crossover (sum) with a bootstrap interval, uncorrected
hypotheses.H2: f_ign beats val, mp, ent, atc, dis, dev and params on l_new
hypotheses.exploratory: H3 calibration slope of l_new on 1 - k_deploy; H4 per-world range across selectors of l_beyond minus that of l_win; H5 f_ign8 and f_ign16 against f_ign; H6 per-lag curves; H7 share of worlds in which k_known deploys win4
hypotheses.interpretation: if f_ign and k_known deploy the same candidate in most worlds and H1 fails, capacity did not bind and E4 is reported as a null beside E1

stats.signflip: one million random flips for 32 worlds

pilot.G1: passed, 0.514 of candidates reach source return 0.9
pilot.updates: 300 kept (width-32 recurrent cells still improve after 150)

code: e4/rprev.py, e4/ppo4.py, e4/world.py, e4/anal4.py, e4/fig4.py, e4/run4.sh; common/fsel.py multinomial functions and common/anal.py tol option (defaults unchanged)
commands: e4/run4.sh e4/plan.json runs/e4 16  (train, source, open, target, anal4), then python3 e4/fig4.py runs/e4
